title: Third Life series
description: Third Life is a Minecraft data pack based on the Third Life YouTube series by Grian, featuring Scar, Bdubs, and many other creators.
body:
## Description:
Bring the excitement of the Third Life YouTube series to your own Minecraft world with this data pack. Inspired by Grian, Scar, Bdubs, and the rest of the Life Series creators, it recreates the series' core mechanics, where every player begins with three lives. As lives are lost, the stakes rise, alliances are tested, betrayals become common, and survival becomes the only goal. Whether you're playing with friends or hosting a multiplayer server, this data pack delivers the tense, unpredictable gameplay that made the series so popular.
